create.name: Jillian Pransky
create.bio:
Jillian Pransky is an American yoga and mindfulness teacher who has been leading classes, trainings and retreats for around thirty years. She trained in the ISHTA lineage with Alan Finger in the mid-1990s, later took Erich Schiffmann as her main yoga influence, and has followed the teachings of Pema Chödrön since 1998, alongside study with figures such as Jack Kornfield, Tara Brach and Sharon Salzberg. A certified yoga therapist, she is the author of Deep Listening and The Power of the Pause.

Slowing down sits at the heart of her work. She is known for restorative yoga, unhurried slow-flow sequences and metta meditation, and for a six-step, ninety-second practice she calls LAR-LAR (land, arrive, relax, listen, attend, respond) for meeting hard moments with more presence and kindness. Each season she leads retreats at Kripalu, Omega Institute, Feathered Pipe Ranch in Montana and Blue Spirit in Costa Rica, often with the composer Garth Stevenson playing live. Online, she runs a membership studio with new weekly classes and a recorded library, and hosts free Friday meditations that anyone can join.

books.title: Deep Listening: A Healing Practice to Calm Your Body, Clear Your Mind, and Open Your Heart
books.author: Jillian Pransky
books.description: Her first book, combining personal story with a step-by-step programme of restorative yoga, breath awareness and meditation. It invites readers to notice where they hold tension and to meet themselves with patience and warmth.

courses.title: Kripalu: Deep Renewal in the Heart of Autumn
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in the Berkshires of Massachusetts with slow-flow and restorative yoga, meditation and time outdoors among the autumn colours. Live music comes from Garth Stevenson and Kristen Ambrosi.

courses.title: Costa Rica – Spring Revival in Paradise
courses.description: A week at Blue Spirit on Costa Rica's Pacific coast with daily slow-flow yoga, restorative rest and mindfulness practice. The setting between jungle and ocean is part of the programme.

courses.title: Kripalu: Begin Again – Return to Your True Nature
courses.description: A spring weekend at Kripalu built around gentle yoga, meditation and restorative poses, with walks in nature. One session features live music from Garth Stevenson.

courses.title: Feathered Pipe Retreat: The Spacious Pause
courses.description: A week at Feathered Pipe Ranch in Montana combining mindful yoga, somatic movement, restorative practice and plenty of rest. Guests include Garth Stevenson and the poet Heidi Rose Robbins.

courses.title: Pausing in the Great In-Between
courses.description: An autumn equinox weekend on Omega's Rhinebeck campus to slow down, take stock and reconnect at a turning point of the year. Practice includes restorative yoga, meditation and time in nature.

courses.title: Online Studio Membership
courses.description: A monthly membership with new live and recorded classes each week, themed series and a library of more than three hundred slow-flow, restorative and meditation practices. There is a two-week free trial.

free_resources.title: Free Friday Meditations
free_resources.description: A free meditation she leads live on Zoom on Friday mornings through the year, with a short dharma talk and recordings for registered participants. No experience is needed; donations are optional.

flags: Her own pages frame much of the work around chronic stress, anxiety and nervous-system regulation (and her YouTube channel calls itself a sanctuary for 'somatic healing'). The yoga, meditation and retreat items kept are described without that framing; anything condition-named is left out. A human may want to judge whether the overall framing is acceptable.
Email info@jillianpransky.com is published as the email icon link in the site footer on every page (incl. the contact page), not as written text; the contact page itself has a 'contact us' button.
Only one photo used: the Omega headshot. Site images are group shots, distant seated poses or carry a magazine photo credit.

Availability set to worldwide: she taught a weekly in-studio class at Jaipure Yoga, Montclair, NJ through June 2026, but no current in-person classes are listed; could be local_online (Montclair, NJ) if that resumes.
Kept Deep Listening: its subtitle says 'a healing practice' but names no condition; the Amazon blurb mentions her own past anxiety as biography, not as a treatment promise. Borderline.
Kripalu retreat prices read from kripalu.org pages linked from her event pages; Feathered Pipe price from featheredpipe.com.
left_out: The Power of the Pause (book, ASIN 1454959126): her own book page and blurb sell it on 'disrupting cycles of chronic stress and anxiety' and the 6-week journey on regulating the nervous system; left out under the strict health-claim rule
Restorative Ease for Chronic Stress & Illness (course): condition-named
Restorative Yoga Teacher Training 2025 ($1,399): page says self-paced access only through April 2026; looks stale
Autumn Attunement: The Chakras & The Vagus Nerve series ($249): already under way, and vagus-nerve framing
Esalen retreat (9–12 Oct 2026), Omega 2026, Feathered Pipe 2026 and Kripalu 2026 summer/spring retreats: passed
